title: English Practice Quiz 0222
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: The windows ___ every week.
questions.explanation: Plural subject windows takes are + past participle.

questions.question: The test was ___ than I expected.
They ___ ready for the meeting.
questions.explanation: Use are with the plural subject they.

questions.question: At 8 p.m. yesterday, I ___ dinner.
questions.explanation: Use the past continuous for an action in progress at a specific past time.

questions.question: If a task is 'urgent', it needs ___.
questions.explanation: Urgent means requiring immediate or prompt attention.

questions.question: Mount Everest is ___ highest mountain in the world.
Choose the correct word order.
questions.explanation: Frequency adverbs such as always usually come after the verb be.

questions.question: Which word has a silent 'k'?
questions.explanation: The k in know is silent.

questions.question: You need to report a problem. You say:
options: There is an issue with the printer.
questions.explanation: There is an issue with... clearly introduces a problem.

questions.question: Which is a complete sentence?
questions.explanation: The team finished the work contains a subject and a complete predicate.
